name: tc01_ecu_connectivity
title: ECU connectivity
req: A simulated ECU shall answer a diagnostic probe; disconnected ECU is a communication error.
debug: Break at probe(); inspect connected. Expected offline case must PASS.
exercise: Add a malformed reply case and reject it separately.

name: tc02_voltage
title: ECU voltage boundary validation
req: Measured voltage must be 9–16 V inclusive (example requirement).
debug: Inspect 8.99 and 16.01; run with -O to see the guard.
exercise: Add 9.01 and 15.99; deliberately change an expected outcome to see exit 1.

name: tc03_can_range
title: CAN signal range
req: Decoded speed samples must be between 0 and 250 km/h.
debug: Inspect index and value in the loop; the error includes the failing sample.
exercise: Add a missing-signal scenario and a dedicated exception.

name: tc04_can_timeout
title: CAN message timeout and retry
req: Receive a frame within three simulated polling attempts.
debug: Inspect attempt and frame. No real clock is required for this deterministic exercise.
exercise: Implement a real deadline with time.monotonic() for a mocked receiver.

name: tc05_can_cycle
title: CAN message cycle time
req: Adjacent timestamps must be 100 ms apart with tolerance of 5 ms.
debug: Inspect intervals; average alone can hide a single late frame.
exercise: Add minimum, maximum and jitter to the debug log.

name: tc06_software_version
title: Software version verification
req: A release string must match MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH and the requested version.
debug: Inspect re.fullmatch result; match the whole string, not just a prefix.
exercise: Support a release candidate suffix such as -rc1.

name: tc07_flashing
title: ECU flashing result
req: A simulated flasher must exit zero and print an explicit success marker.
debug: Inspect returncode, stdout and stderr. Do not trust a success string alone.
exercise: Add a simulated subprocess timeout and handle TimeoutExpired.

name: tc08_uds_response
title: UDS response validation
req: Simulated ReadDataByIdentifier F190 response must begin with 62 F1 90 and contain a 17-byte VIN.
debug: Inspect response.hex(); distinguish negative response from malformed positive response.
exercise: Add a negative response with NRC 0x31 and verify classification.

name: tc09_dtc
title: DTC verification
req: Decoded active DTCs must contain no entries outside the example allowlist.
debug: Inspect unexpected set; duplicates are deliberately collapsed.
exercise: Distinguish active and stored DTC status.

name: tc10_reset_recovery
title: ECU reset and recovery
req: After a simulated reset, ECU must become ready within 3 seconds.
debug: Inspect simulated elapsed_ms; no physical reset is performed.
exercise: Add a transient READY state and require two consecutive ready samples.

name: tc11_vehicle_speed
title: Vehicle speed tolerance
req: Measured speed must stay within 2 km/h of reference for each aligned sample.
debug: Inspect df.loc[bad]; missing values must not silently pass.
exercise: Add timestamp alignment using merge_asof with an explicit tolerance.

name: tc12_cluster_warning
title: Instrument cluster warning indicator
req: Example rule: seatbelt warning is ON when ignition is on and driver belt is unfastened.
debug: Compare expected vs observed; test every input combination.
exercise: Add a separate warning rule for low fuel.

name: tc13_dlt_log
title: DLT text log error detection
req: An exported plain-text log must contain no ERROR or FATAL entries.
debug: Inspect matches with line numbers; this is not a binary DLT parser.
exercise: Add an allowlist for a known benign error and log excluded lines.

name: tc14_csv_signals
title: BLF-exported CSV signal validation
req: Exported CSV must contain monotonically increasing timestamps and voltage within limits.
debug: Inspect dtypes and df.loc[bad]; BLF decoding is outside this exercise.
exercise: Add signal unit conversion and detect duplicated timestamps.

name: tc15_startup_time
title: ECU startup time
req: Time from startup command to ready event must not exceed 1500 ms.
debug: Mocked monotonic clock avoids flaky sleeps. Inspect elapsed_ms.
exercise: Test a missing ready event with a dedicated timeout exception.

name: tc16_sensor_consistency
title: Sensor data consistency
req: Two synchronized sensor streams must differ by no more than 0.5 units.
debug: Check length before zip; zip otherwise silently truncates the longer list.
exercise: Handle NaN and timestamp alignment explicitly.

name: tc17_bench_health
title: HiL test bench health check
req: Power, network and CAN interface must all be available before test execution.
concept: OOP, dataclass, custom exceptions, critical logs
debug: Inspect unavailable components; distinguish infrastructure failure from DUT failure.
exercise: Add a separate class for bench configuration and a retry policy.

name: tc18_build
title: Embedded build verification
req: A simulated build must finish with exit zero and a build-success marker.
debug: Inspect stderr and returncode. This is a fake build, not a compiler invocation.
exercise: Replace the fake process with your own local CMake project.

name: tc19_jenkins_logs
title: Jenkins failure classification
req: A log analyser must identify example disk, compiler and timeout failures.
debug: Inspect rule order; first match wins. Unknown is not evidence of success.
exercise: Support multiple matching categories and show evidence lines.

name: tc20_pytest_regression
title: Pytest parametrized regression
req: Voltage validation shall accept inclusive limits and reject out-of-range inputs.
concept: pytest fixtures, parametrization, pytest.raises, JUnit XML
debug: Run python -m pytest -vv --pdb scripts/tc20_pytest_regression.py to debug a failure.
exercise: Add a pytest fixture finalizer and an invalid-type test.

name: tc21_configuration
title: Test configuration validation
req: Test configuration must contain ECU ID and a positive integer timeout.
concept: JSON, dictionaries, type checks, custom exception
debug: Inspect config and missing fields. bool is a subclass of int; use exact type.
exercise: Add a schema version and validate allowed communication protocols.

name: tc22_reporting
title: Test report generation
req: JSON and CSV reports must preserve each test ID and verdict.
concept: JSON, CSV, file handling, round-trip assertions
debug: Inspect reread rows; reject invalid verdict before writing.
exercise: Add a pass-rate summary and ERROR verdict for infrastructure failures.

name: tc23_resources
title: CPU and memory resource limits
req: Example bench thresholds: CPU <= 85%, RAM <= 90%.
debug: Mock values are deterministic; live psutil measurements vary across machines.
exercise: Record multiple samples and evaluate sustained utilization.

name: tc24_network
title: Network connectivity and latency
req: A simulated endpoint must connect and respond within 100 ms.
debug: Inspect socket mock side effects; no real network or ECU is contacted.
exercise: Use a local loopback service to measure actual connection latency.

name: tc25_cleanup
title: Test resource cleanup
req: A simulated bench reservation must always be released, even when a test fails.
debug: Inspect release.call_count after the exception.
exercise: Implement a context manager using contextlib.contextmanager.
